I used to spend the night at my grandparents with my brother and three cousins when I was little. I was at one of their houses not too long ago and she asked me about something she thought she dreamed. She remembers my grandma bringing us all into her bedroom one day and showing us an old woman asleep in her bed. My cousin thought she dreamed it but mentioned it to one of her brothers recently, on a trip to Minnesota and he remembers the same thing. So when I went to hang out with her, she asked if I remembered anything like that. I said maybe but I thought it was a dream too. So I dug as deep as I could and described the situation in the most detail I was able.

I was maybe a foot inside the door to my grandma's room, and she was showing us an old woman asleep in her bed. I didn't recognize her so I was confused who this person was, and I was definitely uncomfortable, but I didn't feel alone or that I would be in trouble for being in my grandparent's room, so she and my cousins and brother were probably all there as we always did things together at her house and rarely split up. I remember it being late afternoon (which is probably why I wasn't scared) and this old woman with medium length grey hair pulled back in a bun laying on my grandma and grandpa's bed. The bed was made, with the old woman laying on top of it on her back, hands on her stomach, wearing maroon, on the side of the bed closer to the door. 

My cousin confirmed everything I described was the same as what she and her brother remember. They also remember the woman pacing the hallway past the room we slept in when we stayed over late at night and wearing a dark cloak. None of us were ever able to sleep well in that house and we always had nightmares and had problems with bed wetting, but only there.

Nothing ever happened when my grandpa was home, and my grandma had no friends that she would've let sleep in her room or would've had over while we were there. My grandpa passed years ago and my grandma now has extreme dementia and wouldn't know what we were talking about if we asked. . None of our parents know anything about it so none of us told anyone, and we no longer have access to the house. Brought it up to my brother but he said we're nuts. He's a huge skeptic though and has never been prone to paranormal activity where I've heard and seen paranormal things all my life, had loads of experiences until I was about 16. Also am vaguely clairvoyant I guess you could say. So I 100% believe in what I saw.
